items.name: trading-theme
items.title: Trading theme
items.description: Direction tokens (up / down / flat) and chart surface tokens layered onto the shadcn palette, in light, dark, and a deuteranopia-safe variant.

items.name: trading-lib
items.title: Trading utilities
items.description: Number and time formatting, tick rounding, canvas scales, and the hooks the charts need (element size, price flash, reduced motion).

items.name: mock-market
items.title: Mock market feed
items.description: Seeded, deterministic market data: OHLCV bars, an order book, prints and quotes, plus a hook that ticks them. For demos, stories and tests - not market data.

items.name: trading-provider
items.title: TradingProvider
items.description: Scopes theme, direction palette and instrument formatting defaults to a subtree.

items.name: panel-boundary
items.title: PanelBoundary
items.description: React error boundary that contains a render fault to one widget instead of unmounting the terminal, with resetKeys recovery and an onError hook for your reporter.

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: Widget frame: fixed header, flexible body that shrinks inside a grid layout.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Interval picker and side switch on Radix ToggleGroup, with buy/sell direction tinting and no way to end up with nothing selected.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number field
items.description: Price and quantity entry that keeps your keystrokes intact and refuses to change value on scroll.

items.name: price
items.title: Price
items.description: Tabular price with optional tick flash and big-figure emphasis.

items.name: delta
items.title: Delta
items.description: Change indicator that carries direction three ways - color, icon and sign - so it survives grayscale and colorblindness.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: Labelled figure for a KPI strip.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: Inline SVG trend line with optional area fill and baseline.

items.name: candle-chart
items.title: Candle chart
items.description: Canvas OHLC chart: candles, hollow candles, line or area, with volume, moving averages, crosshair and an OHLC readout.

items.name: depth-chart
items.title: Depth chart
items.description: Cumulative bid/ask depth, drawn as steps rather than a smoothed curve.

items.name: order-book
items.title: Order book
items.description: Ladder or two-column book with depth bars scaled across both sides, a spread row, and markers for your own resting orders.

items.name: trade-tape
items.title: Trade tape
items.description: Time and sales, colored by aggressor side, with block-print highlighting.

items.name: ticker-tape
items.title: Ticker tape
items.description: Seamless scrolling quote strip that pauses on hover and stops entirely under prefers-reduced-motion.

items.name: watchlist
items.title: Watchlist
items.description: Symbol list with price, change and an inline sparkline, as a real listbox.

items.name: symbol-header
items.title: Symbol header
items.description: Instrument banner: last price with tick flash, day change, bid/ask and range.

items.name: order-ticket
items.title: Order ticket
items.description: Order entry with tick-snapped prices, a size slider, live cost estimate, an optional confirm dialog, and validation that blocks fat-fingers but only warns about legitimate risk.

items.name: positions-table
items.title: Positions table
items.description: Open positions marked to market, with signed quantities so shorts need no special case.

items.name: order-blotter
items.title: Order blotter
items.description: Today's orders and their state, with inline cancel.

items.name: fills-table
items.title: Fills table
items.description: Executions rather than instructions: every fill with its price, fee and maker/taker flag, totalled at the quantity-weighted average.

items.name: indicator-pane
items.title: Indicator pane
items.description: The sub-pane under a price chart: Wilder RSI, MACD with histogram, or volume - on its own scale, sharing the chart x-axis.

items.name: buy-sell-buttons
items.title: Buy / sell buttons
items.description: One-click dealing buttons with live bid and offer and the spread between them, in the FX layout: sell left, buy right.

items.name: quick-trade-bar
items.title: Quick trade bar
items.description: Preset sizes, buy and sell, and flatten / reverse kept behind a rule so a size chip is never next to a close-everything button.

items.name: bracket-fields
items.title: Bracket + leverage
items.description: Stop loss and take profit with the risk/reward the pair actually implies, plus a leverage selector that states the liquidation distance.

items.name: interval-picker
items.title: Interval picker
items.description: Chart timeframes: favourites stay one click away, the rest live in a grouped dropdown, and the active interval is always visible.

items.name: time-range-picker
items.title: Time range picker
items.description: 1D through ALL, with a calendar-aware resolver so YTD means January 1st and a month back from the 31st is not thirty days.

items.name: session-clock
items.title: Session clock
items.description: Market phase and a countdown to the next change, with pre and post sessions and a real always-open case for crypto.

items.name: dom-ladder
items.title: DOM ladder
items.description: Click-to-trade depth of market on a fixed price axis, so the level under your cursor is still that level when you click.

items.name: volume-profile
items.title: Volume profile
items.description: Volume at price with point of control and value area, spreading each bar across the range it actually covered.

items.name: market-heatmap
items.title: Market heatmap
items.description: Squarified treemap sized by weight and coloured by direction, for a market or a book.

items.name: quote-grid
items.title: Quote grid
items.description: A dense, sortable multi-instrument quote board with inline trends.

items.name: day-range-bar
items.title: Day range bar
items.description: Where price sits inside its day range, with the 52-week range on the same track so the two stay comparable.

items.name: pnl-chart
items.title: P&L chart
items.description: Equity curve with drawdown shaded from the running peak, because "up on the day" and "below the high-water mark" are different questions.

items.name: account-summary
items.title: Account summary
items.description: Equity, day P&L, buying power and a banded margin meter that marks the thresholds rather than fading through them.

items.name: exposure-bar
items.title: Exposure bar
items.description: Gross exposure as a stacked bar with longs and shorts on separate tracks, so a hedged book does not read as flat.

items.name: allocation-bar
items.title: Allocation bar
items.description: Portfolio weights by gross exposure as one stacked bar plus a legend, with a concentration warning and shorts hatched as well as coloured.

items.name: connection-status
items.title: Connection status
items.description: Feed health with latency and staleness, treating "connected but slow" as its own state rather than a green dot.

items.name: symbol-search
items.title: Symbol search
items.description: Command-palette instrument search, ranked so an exact ticker beats a prefix beats a company-name hit.

items.name: price-alerts
items.title: Price alerts
items.description: Alert levels with how far away each one is, and triggered alerts that stay in the list instead of vanishing.

items.name: trading-terminal
items.title: Trading terminal
items.description: Every trading-ui component at once: chart, book, depth, tape, ticket, positions and blotter.
